description: This file defines the BillingConductorClient class for interacting with the AWS Billing Conductor service. It extends the AwsClient class and provides method signatures for various billing-related operations such as associating accounts, creating billing groups, listing billing reports, and managing pricing rules, with both synchronous and asynchronous variants.

classes.name: BillingConductorClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the AWSBillingConductor service, providing methods for managing billing and pricing.

methods.name: associateAccounts
methods.description: Associates accounts with the billing conductor.

methods.name: associateAccountsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates accounts with the billing conductor.

methods.name: batchAssociateResourcesToCustomLineItem
methods.description: Batch associates resources to a custom line item.

methods.name: batchAssociateResourcesToCustomLineItemAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously batch associates resources to a custom line item.

methods.name: batchDisassociateResourcesFromCustomLineItem
methods.description: Batch disassociates resources from a custom line item.

methods.name: batchDisassociateResourcesFromCustomLineItemAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously batch disassociates resources from a custom line item.

methods.name: createBillingGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new billing group.

methods.name: createCustomLineItemAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a custom line item.

methods.name: createPricingPlanAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new pricing plan.

methods.name: createPricingRuleAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new pricing rule.

methods.name: deleteCustomLineItemAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a custom line item.

methods.name: getBillingGroupCostReport
methods.description: Retrieves the cost report for a billing group.

methods.name: getBillingGroupCostReportAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the billing group cost report.

methods.name: listBillingGroupCostReportsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists billing group cost reports.

methods.name: listCustomLineItemVersions
methods.description: Lists versions of a custom line item.

methods.name: listCustomLineItemVersionsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists custom line item versions.

methods.name: listPricingPlansAssociatedWithPricingRule
methods.description: Lists pricing plans associated with a specific pricing rule.

methods.name: listPricingPlansAssociatedWithPricingRuleAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists pricing plans associated with a pricing rule.

methods.name: listPricingRulesAssociatedToPricingPlan
methods.description: Lists pricing rules associated with a specific pricing plan.

methods.name: listPricingRulesAssociatedToPricingPlanAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists pricing rules associated with a pricing plan.

methods.name: listResourcesAssociatedToCustomLineItem
methods.description: Lists resources associated with a custom line item.

methods.name: listResourcesAssociatedToCustomLineItemAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists resources associated with a custom line item.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
